verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
When I am weak, that's when You are strong
When I let go, I fall into Your arms

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
I take up Your yoke
I know that it's so easy
I take up Your burden that's light

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
I look into Your eyes of mercy
I look into Your eyes of love
I remember that Your heart, it's for me

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
I'm holding on to Your divine love
I'm holding on and I'm not letting go
It's not my zeal, it's that Your love is strong
It's not my strength, it's that You're faithful

verse.name: o1a
verse.lines:
I'm holding on to the love
That has laid hold of me

verse.name: o2
verse.lines:
Where could I run from You
Where could I hide
Your love has made
An everlasting mark on my heart

verse.name: o3
verse.lines:
Even when I cannot see You
Even when I cannot feel You
Even when I feel alone
I'll keep loving You God

verse.name: o4
verse.lines:
Even in the midst of danger
Even in the midst of trials
Even in the face of death
I'll keep loving You God

verse.name: o5
verse.lines:
How great is the love
The Father has lavished on us
How great is the love
We will remember, we will remember

verse.name: o1b
verse.lines:
I'll keep trusting You God
I'll keep trusting You God

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
How great is the love the Father has lavished on us
You gave Your Son
Help us will remember, help us remember
